title: NoAITell Refund Policy | NoAITell
description: NoAITell does not currently accept payments. Read the status of upcoming paid plans and refunds.
body:
Effective November 4, 2026. NoAITell currently offers a free local cleaner and does not accept payments. Every upgrade button is disabled and marked Coming soon. There are no active subscriptions, charged day passes or paid entitlements to cancel in this release.

The pricing page previews a $4.99 24-hour day pass, a $19.9 monthly plan and a $199 yearly plan. These prices do not create an order. Creem is the planned payment provider for a future release; no checkout or payment webhook is connected here.

Before paid plans launch, this page will provide the applicable refund request process, support contact, eligibility conditions and cancellation information. Those details will be available before checkout, together with the final purchase terms.

If you see a charge you believe is associated with NoAITell, check the merchant information on your receipt and contact the payment provider shown there. Do not send card details or private drafts through a public issue tracker. Any mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.
